title: Town Hall Audience Member - Key & Peele

segments.description: Medium shot of a congressman speaking passionately about working for everyone during a town hall meeting.
Medium close-up of audience members listening attentively as the politician lists various demographic groups.
Medium close-up shot of Jordan Peele as an audience member listening with a deadpan, increasingly uncomfortable expression.
Medium shot of the congressman gesturing broadly while advocating for marriage equality and LGBTQ+ rights.
Close-up shot of Jordan Peele looking around nervously and deciding to slide off his chair onto the floor.
Medium shot of Jordan Peele hiding under the chairs while fellow audience members glance down in confusion.
Medium tracking shot of the politician asking everyone to turn and look at the gay person next to them.
Wide shot of the audience turning to look at Jordan Peele hiding on the floor, ending in comedic applause.
